title: When Two Giants Intersect: Healthcare Meets Fintech

reader_summary.headline: Until recently, it was nearly impossible to figure out what something cost.
reader_summary.overview: Until recently, it was nearly impossible to figure out what something cost. What words come to mind when you think of buying something with the click of a button? How about just tapping your card to pay? Or your credit card being paid off automatically, or even your credit card company automatically detecting fraud.

key_points.text: Well, when I think of those things, the words that come to mind are things like seamless, clean, easy.

thesis: The speakers argue that the healthcare system is broken due to a fundamental misalignment of incentives caused by the separation of care delivery and payment processing. They propose that the intersection of healthcare and fintech, supported by regulatory and technological changes, offers a path to re-examine this three-party system and create a better future.
